# xterm.js

[xterm.js](https://xtermjs.org) 6.0.0 (`@xterm/xterm`) and its fit addon 0.11.0
(`@xterm/addon-fit`), as published to npm (`lib/xterm.js`, `css/xterm.css`,
`lib/addon-fit.js`, with the source map comments removed), for the terminal
pane. MIT, see `LICENSE`. To upgrade, replace these files whole.
